description: This file defines a handler class for managing guardrail translation for a rerank endpoint in a machine learning or NLP application. The core functionality includes processing input data by applying guardrails to the 'query' parameter and overriding the output processing method to do nothing, as rerank responses do not require guardrail application.

classes.name: CohereRerankHandler
classes.description: A class that extends BaseTranslation to handle guardrail translation specifically for rerank requests, processing the 'query' parameter before rerank responses are returned.

methods.name: Any process_input_messages( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously applies guardrails to the 'query' parameter within the input data dictionary.

methods.name: Any process_output_response( self, response: "RerankResponse", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Overrides base method to return the response unmodified, as rerank responses do not require guardrails.

ctags.name: process_input_messages
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )

ctags.name: process_output_response
ctags.signature: ( self, response: "RerankResponse", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
